summary: Phase 4 of 8 complete: all 15 per-system `<sys>_axiom_sound` proofs (K, T, D, B, K4, K5, K45, S4, S5, TB, KB5, D4, D5, D45, DB) in `Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/Systems/*/Soundness.lean` now route through the single master `unionSound` lemma (`Cslib/Logics/Modal/Metalogic/SchemaSoundness.lean`, Phase 2) fed by that system's Phase-3 tag set + bridge equivalence (`Cslib/Logics/Modal/ProofSystem/SchemaBridges.lean`). Each proof reduces to `unionSound sysTags m (fun t ht => by fin_cases ht <;> trivial) (bridge.mpr h_ax) w` -- the per-system 13-constructor case-split is gone. `fin_cases ht` substitutes the concrete tag for each element of `sysTags`; Lean's `trivial` tactic (rfl/contradiction/assumption) closes the 13 core-tag `True` goals AND every differentiator-tag goal via its `assumption` fallback, since the system's frame hypothesis (`h_refl`/`h_trans`/`h_symm`/`h_serial`/`h_eucl`) is already in local context after substitution -- no system needed an explicit `exact h_*` branch. This was discovered mid-dispatch: a first-attempt `first | trivial | exact h_*` form (following the task's suggested shape) built green on K45/S4 (sub-phase 4.2) but the compiler's `linter.unreachableTactic`/`linter.unusedTactic` flagged the `exact` branches as dead code; root-caused and simplified retroactively across sub-phases 4.1-4.3 in the same dispatch (4.4 used the simplified form from the start). S5's `modalB` (symmetry) obligation -- which pre-migration was proved inline from `h_refl`+`h_eucl` since S5 = T+4+B and never took an `h_symm` parameter -- is now a local `have h_symm := fun w₁ w₂ hr => h_eucl w₁ w₂ w₁ hr (h_refl w₁)` feeding the same uniform `hfc` term, preserving `s5_axiom_sound`'s exact original signature. `fin_cases` required an explicit `public import Mathlib.Tactic.FinCases` added to each of the 15 files (not transitively available via `Cslib.Init`/`SchemaBridges`/`SchemaSoundness`; caught on the first K build attempt, which errored 'unknown tactic') -- permitted since only the 15 `Systems/*/Soundness.lean` files were in scope. Every public theorem/instance name is byte-stable (`k_soundness`, `k_soundness_derivable`, all 15 `<sys>_axiom_sound`, all 15 `<sys>_soundness`) -- only the `_axiom_sound` proof bodies changed; the `_soundness`/`_soundness_derivable` wrappers already just called `<sys>_axiom_sound` and needed no edits. Executed sequentially as sub-phases 4.1 (K/T/D/B), 4.2 (K4/K5/K45/S4), 4.3 (S5/TB/KB5 + retroactive hfc simplification across 4.1-4.3), 4.4 (D4/D5/D45/DB), each committed independently once green. Zero sorry across all 15 files (full grep), zero new axiom (spot-checked via `lean_verify` on `k_soundness`, `k45_soundness`, `s5_soundness`, `d45_soundness`, `b_axiom_sound`, `s4_axiom_sound`, `kb5_axiom_sound`, `db_axiom_sound` -- all report only propext/Classical.choice/Quot.sound). Scoped `lake build` of all 15 modules, `lake exe checkInitImports`, and `lake exe lint-style` all green with zero warnings. No file outside `Systems/*/Soundness.lean` was touched -- `SchemaUnion.lean`, `SchemaSoundness.lean`, `SchemaBridges.lean` (Phases 1-3), the 15 instance files, and `DerivationTree.lean` are all unmodified. Net line delta across the 15 files vs. the pre-Phase-4 baseline: 149 insertions, 277 deletions = -128 lines net (`git diff --stat`). Stopping here per single-phase dispatch scope; Phases 5-8 not started.
